name: CAD Mesh to Voxel Conversion
aliases: CAD mesh to voxel conversion for FLUKA
definition: Converts CAD mesh format files (e.g., .stl) into voxelized geometry models (VGMs) readable by FLUKA Monte Carlo code.
summary: CAD Mesh to Voxel Conversion transforms CAD meshes into 3D binary grids for FLUKA Monte Carlo simulations, prioritizing transport accuracy over general rendering.
